BENILLA_INBOXITEMS_TO_DISPLAY = 7 -- INBOXITEMS_TO_DISPLAY (ref MailFrame.lua l.1) BENILLA_MAX_COD_AMOUNT = 10000 -- MAX_COD_AMOUNT (ref l.6) BENILLA_STATIONERY_PATH = "Interface\\Stationery\\" -- STATIONERY_PATH (ref l.5)
-- The money entry uses the shared BenillaMoneyInput_* kit (MerchantFrame.xml, loaded first) — -- the send tab's three numeric edit boxes are named BenillaSendMailMoneyGold/Silver/Copper.
-- ── Load / event dispatch (ref MailFrame_Onload l.8-24 / MailFrame_OnEvent l.26-62) ────── function BenillaMailFrame_OnLoad(frame) frame.pageNum = 1 PanelTemplates_SetNumTabs(frame, 2) PanelTemplates_SetTab(frame, 1) frame:RegisterEvent("MAIL_SHOW") frame:RegisterEvent("MAIL_INBOX_UPDATE") frame:RegisterEvent("MAIL_CLOSED") frame:RegisterEvent("MAIL_SEND_SUCCESS") frame:RegisterEvent("MAIL_FAILED") -- The send tab's player-money purse (ref SmallMoneyFrameTemplate refreshes itself on -- PLAYER_MONEY; the merchant-window precedent). frame:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_MONEY") end
function BenillaMailFrame_OnEvent(frame) if event == "MAIL_SHOW" then ShowUIPanel(frame) if not frame:IsVisible() then CloseMail() return end OpenBackpack() BenillaSendMailFrame_Update() BenillaMailFrameTab_OnClick(1) CheckInbox() -- drains to CMSG_GET_MAIL_LIST (throttled app-side, wow-re §5) elseif event == "MAIL_INBOX_UPDATE" then BenillaInboxFrame_Update() BenillaOpenMail_Update() elseif event == "MAIL_SEND_SUCCESS" then -- Fires on a successful send AND, byte-verified, on window open (the compose-tab -- reset side effect — wow-re §5); either way reset the form + play the page turn. BenillaSendMailFrame_Reset() PlaySound("igAbiliityPageTurn") if BenillaSendMailFrame.sendMode == "reply" then BenillaMailFrameTab_OnClick(1) end elseif event == "MAIL_FAILED" then -- Fires on EVERY SMSG_SEND_MAIL_RESULT for a send (success included, wow-re §5): its -- only job is to re-enable the button so the UI never stays blocked. BenillaSendMailMailButton:Enable() elseif event == "MAIL_CLOSED" then HideUIPanel(frame) elseif event == "PLAYER_MONEY" then -- Repaints the purse AND recolors the postage cost (ref: both money frames -- self-refresh on this event). BenillaSendMailFrame_Update() end end
-- The tab pair + the four corner-texture swaps (ref MailFrameTab_OnClick l.64-93). function BenillaMailFrameTab_OnClick(tab) if not tab then tab = this:GetID() end PanelTemplates_SetTab(BenillaMailFrame, tab) if tab == 1 then BenillaInboxFrame:Show() BenillaSendMailFrame:Hide() BenillaMailFrameTopLeft:SetTexture("Interface\\ItemTextFrame\\UI-ItemText-TopLeft") BenillaMailFrameTopRight:SetTexture("Interface\\Spellbook\\UI-SpellbookPanel-TopRight") BenillaMailFrameBotLeft:SetTexture("Interface\\ItemTextFrame\\UI-ItemText-BotLeft") BenillaMailFrameBotRight:SetTexture("Interface\\Spellbook\\UI-SpellbookPanel-BotRight") BenillaMailFrameTopLeft:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", "BenillaMailFrame", "TOPLEFT", 0, 0) else BenillaInboxFrame:Hide() BenillaSendMailFrame:Show() BenillaMailFrameTopLeft:SetTexture("Interface\\ClassTrainerFrame\\UI-ClassTrainer-TopLeft") BenillaMailFrameTopRight:SetTexture("Interface\\ClassTrainerFrame\\UI-ClassTrainer-TopRight") BenillaMailFrameBotLeft:SetTexture("Interface\\ClassTrainerFrame\\UI-ClassTrainer-BotLeft") BenillaMailFrameBotRight:SetTexture("Interface\\ClassTrainerFrame\\UI-ClassTrainer-BotRight") BenillaMailFrameTopLeft:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", "BenillaMailFrame", "TOPLEFT", 2, -1) BenillaSendMailFrame_Update() BenillaSendMailFrame.sendMode = "send" end PlaySound("igSpellBookOpen") end
-- ── Inbox (ref InboxFrame_Update l.97-199): the row's clickable child is $parentButton, so -- every getglobal below reads MailItem<i>Button* / MailItem<i>Sender/Subject/ExpireTime. ─ function BenillaInboxFrame_Update() local numItems = GetInboxNumItems() local index = ((BenillaMailFrame.pageNum - 1) * BENILLA_INBOXITEMS_TO_DISPLAY) + 1 for i = 1, BENILLA_INBOXITEMS_TO_DISPLAY do if index <= numItems then local packageIcon, stationeryIcon, sender, subject, money, CODAmount, daysLeft, hasItem, wasRead, x, y, z, isGM = GetInboxHeaderInfo(index) local icon if packageIcon and not isGM then icon = packageIcon else icon = stationeryIcon end if not sender then sender = "Unknown" end -- UNKNOWN local button = getglobal("BenillaMailItem"..i.."Button") button:Show() button.index = index button.hasItem = hasItem getglobal("BenillaMailItem"..i.."ButtonIcon"):SetTexture(icon) local subjectText = getglobal("BenillaMailItem"..i.."Subject") subjectText:SetText(subject) local senderText = getglobal("BenillaMailItem"..i.."Sender") senderText:SetText(sender) -- Unread gold / read grey (ref l.130-141; the read icon's SetDesaturation is our -- vertex-grey stand-in — the engine has no desaturation). if wasRead then senderText:SetTextColor(0.75, 0.75, 0.75) subjectText:SetTextColor(0.75, 0.75, 0.75) getglobal("BenillaMailItem"..i.."ButtonSlot"):SetVertexColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) getglobal("BenillaMailItem"..i.."ButtonIcon"):SetVertexColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) else senderText:SetTextColor(1.0, 0.82, 0) -- NORMAL_FONT_COLOR subjectText:SetTextColor(1.0, 1.0, 1.0) -- HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR getglobal("BenillaMailItem"..i.."ButtonSlot"):SetVertexColor(1.0, 0.82, 0) getglobal("BenillaMailItem"..i.."ButtonIcon"):SetVertexColor(1, 1, 1) end -- Expiry: green whole days, red under a day (ref l.142-149: GetText("DAYS_ABBR") -- pluralizes — DAYS_ABBR "Day" / DAYS_ABBR_P1 "Days", GlobalStrings l.895-896; -- the sub-day SecondsToTime is approximated as "< 1 day"). local expireTime = getglobal("BenillaMailItem"..i.."ExpireTime") if daysLeft >= 1 then local days = math.floor(daysLeft) expireTime:SetText(string.format("|cff20ff20%d %s|r", days, days == 1 and "Day" or "Days")) else expireTime:SetText("|cffff2020< 1 day|r") end -- The expiry tooltip (ref l.150-155). if InboxItemCanDelete(index) then expireTime.tooltip = "Time until message is deleted" -- TIME_UNTIL_DELETED else expireTime.tooltip = "Time until message is returned" -- TIME_UNTIL_RETURNED end expireTime:Show() -- COD tag (ref l.157-164) + money field. if CODAmount > 0 then getglobal("BenillaMailItem"..i.."ButtonCOD"):Show() button.cod = CODAmount else getglobal("BenillaMailItem"..i.."ButtonCOD"):Hide() button.cod = nil end if money > 0 then button.money = money else button.money = nil end if BenillaInboxFrame.openMailID == index then button:SetChecked(1) else button:SetChecked(nil) end else getglobal("BenillaMailItem"..i.."Button"):Hide() getglobal("BenillaMailItem"..i.."Sender"):SetText("") getglobal("BenillaMailItem"..i.."Subject"):SetText("") getglobal("BenillaMailItem"..i.."ExpireTime"):Hide() end index = index + 1 end -- Page arrows (ref l.188-198). if BenillaMailFrame.pageNum == 1 then BenillaInboxPrevPageButton:Disable() else BenillaInboxPrevPageButton:Enable() end if (BenillaMailFrame.pageNum * BENILLA_INBOXITEMS_TO_DISPLAY) < numItems then BenillaInboxNextPageButton:Enable() else BenillaInboxNextPageButton:Disable() end -- InboxCurrentPage is declared in the ref XML (l.329) but NO reference Lua ever writes -- it — the real 1.12 window shows nothing there, so neither do we. end
-- Row click: open / close the letter (ref InboxFrame_OnClick l.201-213; this = the button). function BenillaInboxFrame_OnClick(index) if this:GetChecked() then BenillaInboxFrame.openMailID = index BenillaOpenMail_Update() ShowUIPanel(BenillaOpenMailFrame) PlaySound("igSpellBookOpen") else BenillaInboxFrame.openMailID = 0 HideUIPanel(BenillaOpenMailFrame) end BenillaInboxFrame_Update() end
-- Row hover: the enclosed item (SetInboxItem) + the enclosed-money / COD lines (ref -- InboxFrameItem_OnEnter l.215-240; this = the button). function BenillaInboxFrameItem_OnEnter(button) GameTooltip:SetOwner(button, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") if button.hasItem then GameTooltip:SetInboxItem(button.index) end if button.money then if button.hasItem then GameTooltip:AddLine(" ") end GameTooltip:AddLine("Enclosed amount", "", 1, 1, 1) -- ENCLOSED_MONEY SetTooltipMoney(GameTooltip, button.money) elseif button.cod then if button.hasItem then GameTooltip:AddLine(" ") end GameTooltip:AddLine("Cash on Delivery Amount:", "", 1, 1, 1) -- COD_AMOUNT SetTooltipMoney(GameTooltip, button.cod) end GameTooltip:Show() end
function BenillaInboxNextPage() PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") BenillaMailFrame.pageNum = BenillaMailFrame.pageNum + 1 BenillaInboxFrame_Update() end function BenillaInboxPrevPage() PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") BenillaMailFrame.pageNum = BenillaMailFrame.pageNum - 1 BenillaInboxFrame_Update() end
-- ── Open letter (ref OpenMailFrame_OnHide l.256-272 / OpenMail_Update l.274-432) ───────── function BenillaOpenMailFrame_OnHide() StaticPopup_Hide("DELETE_MAIL") if not BenillaInboxFrame.openMailID or BenillaInboxFrame.openMailID == 0 then BenillaInboxFrame_Update() PlaySound("igSpellBookClose") return end local pkg, sta, sender, subject, money, cod, days, itemID, wasRead, wasReturned, textCreated = GetInboxHeaderInfo(BenillaInboxFrame.openMailID) if money == 0 and not itemID and textCreated then DeleteInboxItem(BenillaInboxFrame.openMailID) end BenillaInboxFrame.openMailID = 0 BenillaInboxFrame_Update() PlaySound("igSpellBookClose") end
function BenillaOpenMail_Update() local id = BenillaInboxFrame.openMailID if not id or id == 0 then return end local packageIcon, stationeryIcon, sender, subject, money, CODAmount, daysLeft, hasItem, wasRead, wasReturned, textCreated, canReply = GetInboxHeaderInfo(id) if not sender or not canReply then BenillaOpenMailReplyButton:Disable() else BenillaOpenMailReplyButton:Enable() end if not sender then sender = "Unknown" end BenillaOpenMailSender:SetText(sender) BenillaOpenMailSubject:SetText(subject) BenillaOpenMailFrameIcon:SetTexture(stationeryIcon) -- ref SetPortraitToTexture l.174 local bodyText, texture, isTakeable, isInvoice = GetInboxText(id) BenillaOpenMailBodyText:SetText(bodyText) if texture then BenillaOpenStationeryBackgroundLeft:SetTexture(BENILLA_STATIONERY_PATH..texture.."1") BenillaOpenStationeryBackgroundRight:SetTexture(BENILLA_STATIONERY_PATH..texture.."2") end local hasAttachments -- The letter button — "make a permanent copy" (ref l.364-376): a takeable body not yet -- copied shows the stationery icon; the package button chains off its RIGHT, else -- collapses onto its LEFT so the row stays packed. if isTakeable and not textCreated then getglobal("BenillaOpenMailLetterButtonIcon"):SetTexture(stationeryIcon) BenillaOpenMailLetterButton:Enable() BenillaOpenMailLetterButton:Show() BenillaOpenMailPackageButton:SetPoint("LEFT", "BenillaOpenMailLetterButton", "RIGHT", 10, 0) hasAttachments = 1 else BenillaOpenMailLetterButton:Hide() BenillaOpenMailPackageButton:SetPoint("LEFT", "BenillaOpenMailLetterButton", "LEFT", 0, 0) end local name, itemTexture, count, quality, canUse = GetInboxItem(id) if name then BenillaOpenMailFrame.itemName = name getglobal("BenillaOpenMailPackageButtonIcon"):SetTexture(itemTexture) if (count or 1) > 1 then getglobal("BenillaOpenMailPackageButtonCount"):SetText(count) else getglobal("BenillaOpenMailPackageButtonCount"):SetText("") end if canUse then getglobal("BenillaOpenMailPackageButtonIcon"):SetVertexColor(1, 1, 1) else getglobal("BenillaOpenMailPackageButtonIcon"):SetVertexColor(1.0, 0.1, 0.1) end BenillaOpenMailPackageButton:Enable() BenillaOpenMailPackageButton:Show() BenillaOpenMailMoneyButton:SetPoint("LEFT", "BenillaOpenMailPackageButton", "RIGHT", 10, 0) hasAttachments = 1 else BenillaOpenMailFrame.itemName = nil BenillaOpenMailPackageButton:Hide() BenillaOpenMailMoneyButton:SetPoint("LEFT", "BenillaOpenMailPackageButton", "LEFT", 0, 0) end if CODAmount > 0 then BenillaOpenMailFrame.cod = CODAmount else BenillaOpenMailFrame.cod = nil end if money == 0 then BenillaOpenMailMoneyButton:Hide() BenillaOpenMailFrame.money = nil else getglobal("BenillaOpenMailMoneyButtonIcon"):SetTexture("Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Coin_01") BenillaOpenMailMoneyButton:Enable() BenillaOpenMailMoneyButton:Show() BenillaOpenMailFrame.money = money hasAttachments = 1 end if InboxItemCanDelete(id) then BenillaOpenMailDeleteButton:SetText("Delete") -- DELETE else BenillaOpenMailDeleteButton:SetText("Return") -- MAIL_RETURN end -- The caption + its two positions (ref l.422-431: BOTTOM -68,123 attachments / -5,123 none). if hasAttachments then BenillaOpenMailAttachmentText:SetText("Take Attachments:") -- TAKE_ATTACHMENTS BenillaOpenMailAttachmentText:SetTextColor(1, 1, 1) BenillaOpenMailAttachmentText:SetPoint("BOTTOM", "BenillaOpenMailFrame", "BOTTOM", -68, 123) else BenillaOpenMailAttachmentText:SetText("No Attachments") -- NO_ATTACHMENTS BenillaOpenMailAttachmentText:SetTextColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) BenillaOpenMailAttachmentText:SetPoint("BOTTOM", "BenillaOpenMailFrame", "BOTTOM", -5, 123) end end
-- Reply → Send tab, prefilled "RE: " (ref OpenMail_Reply l.434-447). function BenillaOpenMail_Reply() BenillaMailFrameTab_OnClick(2) BenillaSendMailNameEditBox:SetText(BenillaOpenMailSender:GetText()) local subject = BenillaOpenMailSubject:GetText() local prefix = "RE: " -- MAIL_REPLY_PREFIX.." " if string.sub(subject, 1, string.len(prefix)) ~= prefix then subject = prefix..subject end BenillaSendMailSubjectEditBox:SetText(subject) BenillaSendMailBodyEditBox:SetFocus() BenillaSendMailFrame.sendMode = "reply" end
function BenillaOpenMail_Delete() local id = BenillaInboxFrame.openMailID if InboxItemCanDelete(id) then if BenillaOpenMailFrame.itemName then StaticPopup_Show("DELETE_MAIL", BenillaOpenMailFrame.itemName) return elseif BenillaOpenMailFrame.money then StaticPopup_Show("DELETE_MONEY") return else DeleteInboxItem(id) end else ReturnInboxItem(id) StaticPopup_Hide("COD_CONFIRMATION") end BenillaInboxFrame.openMailID = 0 HideUIPanel(BenillaOpenMailFrame) end
function BenillaOpenMailMoneyButton_OnClick() TakeInboxMoney(BenillaInboxFrame.openMailID) end -- Hovering the coins shows the plain money tooltip (ref OpenMailMoneyButton OnEnter -- l.1823-1829: no header line, just the amount). function BenillaOpenMailMoneyButton_OnEnter(button) if BenillaOpenMailFrame.money then GameTooltip:SetOwner(button, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") SetTooltipMoney(GameTooltip, BenillaOpenMailFrame.money) GameTooltip:Show() end end -- The letter button: copy the body into a bag item (ref OpenMailLetterButton OnClick -- l.1744-1747 → CMSG_MAIL_CREATE_TEXT_ITEM; the OK result stamps COPIED server-side, and -- the list re-sync hides the button via textCreated). function BenillaOpenMailLetterButton_OnClick() TakeInboxTextItem(BenillaInboxFrame.openMailID) PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") end -- Take the item; a COD parcel confirms first (ref OpenMailPackageButton OnClick l.1778-1787). function BenillaOpenMailPackageButton_OnClick() if BenillaOpenMailFrame.cod then StaticPopup_Show("COD_CONFIRMATION") else TakeInboxItem(BenillaInboxFrame.openMailID) end PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") end function BenillaOpenMailPackage_OnEnter(button) GameTooltip:SetOwner(button, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetInboxItem(BenillaInboxFrame.openMailID) if BenillaOpenMailFrame.cod then SetTooltipMoney(GameTooltip, BenillaOpenMailFrame.cod) end GameTooltip:Show() end
-- ── Send tab (ref SendMail* l.484-611 / l.936-960) ────────────────────────────────────── function BenillaSendMailMailButton_OnClick() local copper = BenillaMoneyInput_GetCopper("BenillaSendMailMoney") if BenillaSendMailSendMoneyButton:GetChecked() then SetSendMailCOD(0) if copper > 0 then StaticPopup_Show("SEND_MONEY", BenillaSendMailNameEditBox:GetText()) this:Disable() return end SetSendMailMoney(0) else SetSendMailMoney(0) SetSendMailCOD(copper) end BenillaSendMailFrame_SendMail() this:Disable() end
function BenillaSendMailFrame_SendMail() SendMail(BenillaSendMailNameEditBox:GetText(), BenillaSendMailSubjectEditBox:GetText(), BenillaSendMailBodyEditBox:GetText()) end
function BenillaSendMailFrame_Update() local itemName, itemTexture, stackCount, quality = GetSendMailItem() getglobal("BenillaSendMailPackageButtonIcon"):SetTexture(itemTexture) if (stackCount or 1) <= 1 then stackCount = "" end if itemName then BenillaSendMailCODButton:Enable() BenillaSendMailCODButtonText:SetTextColor(1.0, 0.82, 0) if BenillaSendMailSubjectEditBox:GetText() == "" or BenillaSendMailSubjectEditBox:GetText() == BenillaSendMailFrame.previousItem then BenillaSendMailSubjectEditBox:SetText(itemName) BenillaSendMailFrame.previousItem = itemName end else if BenillaSendMailSubjectEditBox:GetText() == BenillaSendMailFrame.previousItem then BenillaSendMailSubjectEditBox:SetText("") end BenillaSendMailFrame.previousItem = "" BenillaSendMailRadioButton_OnClick(1) BenillaSendMailCODButton:Disable() BenillaSendMailCODButtonText:SetTextColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) end getglobal("BenillaSendMailPackageButtonCount"):SetText(stackCount) BenillaMoney_Set("BenillaSendMailMoneyFrame", GetMoney()) -- The 30c postage (ref l.542-547); red when it exceeds the purse. BenillaMoney_Set("BenillaSendMailCost", GetSendMailPrice()) if GetSendMailPrice() > GetMoney() then BenillaMoney_SetColor("BenillaSendMailCost", 1.0, 0.1, 0.1) else BenillaMoney_SetColor("BenillaSendMailCost", 1.0, 1.0, 1.0) end BenillaSendMailFrame_CanSend() end
function BenillaSendMailFrame_Reset() BenillaSendMailNameEditBox:SetText("") BenillaSendMailSubjectEditBox:SetText("") BenillaSendMailBodyEditBox:SetText("") BenillaMoneyInput_ResetMoney("BenillaSendMailMoney") BenillaSendMailRadioButton_OnClick(1) BenillaSendMailFrame_Update() end
-- SendMailFrame_CanSend (ref l.564-598): name + subject required (stationery is always the -- default here — the picker is omitted); a COD send additionally caps at 10,000g. function BenillaSendMailFrame_CanSend() local checks = 0 local checksRequired = 2 if string.len(BenillaSendMailNameEditBox:GetText()) > 0 then checks = checks + 1 end if string.len(BenillaSendMailSubjectEditBox:GetText()) > 0 then checks = checks + 1 end if BenillaSendMailCODButton:GetChecked() then checksRequired = 3 if BenillaMoneyInput_GetCopper("BenillaSendMailMoney") > BENILLA_MAX_COD_AMOUNT * 10000 then BenillaSendMailErrorText:Show() BenillaSendMailErrorCoin:Show() else BenillaSendMailErrorText:Hide() BenillaSendMailErrorCoin:Hide() checks = checks + 1 end else BenillaSendMailErrorText:Hide() BenillaSendMailErrorCoin:Hide() end if checks == checksRequired then BenillaSendMailMailButton:Enable() else BenillaSendMailMailButton:Disable() end end
function BenillaSendMailRadioButton_OnClick(index) if index == 1 then BenillaSendMailSendMoneyButton:SetChecked(1) BenillaSendMailCODButton:SetChecked(nil) BenillaSendMailMoneyText:SetText("Amount to send:") -- AMOUNT_TO_SEND else BenillaSendMailSendMoneyButton:SetChecked(nil) BenillaSendMailCODButton:SetChecked(1) BenillaSendMailMoneyText:SetText("Cash on Delivery Amount:") -- COD_AMOUNT end PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") BenillaSendMailFrame_CanSend() end
-- The send item slot: a cursor drop (ref SendMailPackageButton_OnClick l.709-721; the cursor -- MONEY drop path is omitted with the cursor-money system). function BenillaSendMailPackageButton_OnClick() ClickSendMailItemButton() BenillaSendMailFrame_Update() end
-- ── The window-owned StaticPopups (ref StaticPopup.lua l.205/220/234/252; the DeathFrame.xml -- house convention). Money frames omitted (the shared engine's money variant is inert). ── StaticPopupDialogs["COD_CONFIRMATION"] = { -- l.205 text = "Accepting this item will cost:", -- COD_CONFIRMATION button1 = "Accept", button2 = "Cancel", OnAccept = function() TakeInboxItem(BenillaInboxFrame.openMailID) end, timeout = 0, hideOnEscape = 1, } StaticPopupDialogs["DELETE_MAIL"] = { -- l.220 text = "Deleting this mail will also destroy %s", -- DELETE_MAIL_CONFIRMATION button1 = "Accept", button2 = "Cancel", OnAccept = function() DeleteInboxItem(BenillaInboxFrame.openMailID) BenillaInboxFrame.openMailID = 0 HideUIPanel(BenillaOpenMailFrame) end, showAlert = 1, timeout = 0, hideOnEscape = 1, } StaticPopupDialogs["DELETE_MONEY"] = { -- l.234 text = "Deleting this mail will also destroy the enclosed money.", -- DELETE_MONEY_CONFIRMATION (money line omitted) button1 = "Accept", button2 = "Cancel", OnAccept = function() DeleteInboxItem(BenillaInboxFrame.openMailID) BenillaInboxFrame.openMailID = 0 HideUIPanel(BenillaOpenMailFrame) end, showAlert = 1, timeout = 0, hideOnEscape = 1, } StaticPopupDialogs["SEND_MONEY"] = { -- l.252 text = "Really send %s the following amount?", -- SEND_MONEY_CONFIRMATION button1 = "Accept", button2 = "Cancel", OnAccept = function() if SetSendMailMoney(BenillaMoneyInput_GetCopper("BenillaSendMailMoney")) then BenillaSendMailFrame_SendMail() end end, OnCancel = function() BenillaSendMailMailButton:Enable() end, timeout = 0, hideOnEscape = 1, }

Scripts.OnEnter: if ( not this.tooltip ) then return end GameTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetText(this.tooltip)

Scripts.OnMouseUp: BenillaSendMailBodyEditBox:SetFocus() if ( CursorHasItem() ) then BenillaSendMailPackageButton_OnClick() end

Scripts.OnEnter: GameTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") if ( GetSendMailItem() ) then GameTooltip:SetSendMailItem() else GameTooltip:SetText("Attach an item to send.", 1.0, 1.0, 1.0) end

Scripts.OnHide: CloseMail() CloseBackpack() HideUIPanel(BenillaOpenMailFrame) BenillaSendMailBodyEditBox:SetText("") BenillaSendMailNameEditBox:SetText("") BenillaSendMailSubjectEditBox:SetText("") PlaySound("igCharacterInfoClose")

Scripts.OnEnter: GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetText("Click to make a permanent\ncopy of this letter.")
